g.text: truST Runtime: Prepared Shared Execution and Checked Host Boundaries
STBC 3.0 declarations, roots, actions and recipes
code, TYPE_TABLE, references, resource and debug records
Ordinary byte preparation transfers validated owned tables;
borrowed/artifact-retaining inputs clone at the shared materializer boundary.
No serialization of current PLC values or lazy materialization occurs in RUN.
Types, imports, instruction targets, construction demand and profile limits
remain validated on every admitted composition, including MCU targets.
Optional register plans alter representation, never the PLC function set.
Portable POU indexes hold sparse IDs and private payload ordinals;
payload capacity and index storage are charged before materialization.
Read-only lookup/iteration preserves ID order; hosted map APIs stay intact.
One execution-frame registry owns reserved/active membership, POU owners
and suspended locals; no parallel live-ID or owner collections.
Tail activation lookup/retirement is direct; non-tail cleanup stays checked.
Per-POU frame plans retain admitted ranges for all initialization phases,
including empty phases and the after-restart static selection.
Declaration owner ranges are prepared once; checked identities preserve
sparse POU IDs and physical slot holes without max-ID-sized allocation.
Typed construction borrows admitted field/variant metadata across callbacks;
owned result dimensions retain charged copies. Marker reads search each
required directory once, admitting work before each lookup and row access.
Owner/root ordinal tables are bounded by admitted record counts;
POU identities fold into full-key-checked buckets; collisions use charged binary fallback. Active type-operation masks
replace repeated membership scans; the type stack still owns depth/unwind.
Marker search plans reserve both destinations before storage publication;
exclusive publication guards retain checked positions without repeated searches.
tasks, construction, fault and execution resources
Public facades do not implement raw mutable execution context traits.
Checked writes normalize against admitted types and commit only after
range, constant, lifetime, binding and deadline checks succeed.
Invalid engineering requests do not themselves latch a PLC fault.
Shared entry state owns one cumulative work/deadline allowance.
Construction reserves and charges the stack buffer, the program
activation's locals, initializer stacks, copy-back journal and image
staging; every scan reuses them and is charged as storage grown on demand.
one opcode loop; no-register calls stay in-loop
prepared compact code of eligible bodies
operand kinds fixed at preparation or cells,
scalar leaves, standard blocks and conversions where they lie
saved caller cursor + leased register scratch
original bytecode instruction costs + bounded helper work
Uniquely owned expression arguments move into function/method bindings;
borrowed inputs, constants and storage reads retain copy admission.
Owned bound locals move into selected callee scratch; declining optimized
execution preserves the original payload for the shared stack fallback.
A single output snapshot enters the active rollback journal directly,
after resolution and growth/copy admission; commit checks remain.
Frame declarations publish local values without persistent instance markers.
Edge qualification reuses the installed POU ID; compatibility callers
retain name resolution and the same edge transaction.
Independent eligible-POU scratch, including frame locals and parameter-presence
payloads, is reserved before RUN and recycled after success or fault. Returned
locals stay leased through caller copyback; recursive re-entry uses stack fallback
until the caller returns that payload.
Borrowed entry payloads retain separately charged, fallible copies.
Nested register re-entry falls back before starting a frame or resetting fuel.
A call to a prepared POU that makes no user call (a leaf) runs to completion
inside the caller's call instruction, with the pump's checks, charges,
completion and failure cleanup; debugging and occupied scratch use the pump.
Hot thresholds and fixed prepared LRU select already compiled blocks.
Profile reset preserves selection; tier reset clears selection/hits,
retains immutable prepared code and requires warmup again.
No std timing/thread-local state or first-use compilation lives in plans.
Stack callers resume from their saved PC and operand scope. Register callers
resume within the selected block at the instruction after the yielded call;
block selection, statement hooks, read counts and instruction charges are not replayed.
The leased per-POU register buffer stays unavailable until completion or unwind.
One shared stack-frame/operand buffer serves stack fallbacks across the activation tree.
Without register-ir, a native user call pushes a child frame and saves
a cursor continuation inside this same opcode loop. Return runs the
shared PreparedCall completion path and restores the parent cursor.
HIR optimized hooks retain their existing synchronous admission order.
A program or final function block body whose instructions all have an
operation, and that keeps no frame variables, runs from compact code
(spec 34 PERF-05). A body whose operand kinds preparation fixes runs on
their bits in the kinded loop; otherwise the typed loop holds its scalar
operands as cells and computes integers and BOOLs on them; any other
operand hands the body to the compact loop. A program body that
initializes nothing in a frame enters without one, and its frame is
pushed when an operation needs it.
Each covered instruction is recorded as the fault site and charged its
unit before its work, an operation's units at once when none samples the
deadline, so results, charges and faults equal the opcode loop's.
physical image acquisition / debug I/O / forces
AfterInputSample: ADS / OPC UA cache copyback
then hosted telemetry and cycle metrics
Pre-submission or driver failure restores touched flat-Q windows.
M and hierarchical effects retain the existing hosted rollback domain.
Successful driver submission commits Q; subsequent deadline/telemetry
faults cannot undo already accepted physical output work.
Ordinary no-hook MCU execution retains its existing publication path.
no initializer replay or storage clone
all drivers attempted; owning fault retained
separate authoring types and copied inspection values
Failed candidate preparation leaves the installed generation unchanged.
A committed restart or replacement installs the next generation: references
taken before it are refused, and the host binds its own references again.
Restart construction has no active debugger observations.
Resource-only binding changes preserve task timing; explicit task changes
reseed registration timing/SINGLE while thread identity history is retained.
Detached snapshots retain real local-slot offsets and ancestor identities.
Compiler scratch names are hidden from user-facing rows.
Snapshot edits never mutate live locals or executable types.
Retired queued frame destinations produce WriteRejected at the next scan.
F407 chip firmware: identity, measured crystal, reset cookie, supervisor
the board's wiring is its configuration
feature stm32f407: crystal measured against HSI, PLL 168 MHz / TIM2 / pins by name / USART2 / IWDG
shared STM32 rules: pin-name grammar, pin table lookup,
reset record and unique ID; depends on no crate
STM32U5A9 chip table, pin names and PLL1 clock tree
register level, no HAL; firmware in S1b-9u
C6 composition: identity, reset cookie, supervisor
Core depends on no board adapter and not on the fixture; the adapters depend on no
runtime or compiler crate: the STM32 adapters share trust-platform-stm32, and the F407
and C6 adapters share trust-platform-memory; firmware has no host runtime dependency.
F407: vectors in sector 0, application sector 1, checkpoint reserves 2/3 and firmware
in sectors 4-11 (960 KiB) stay independently erasable; one firmware for the chip, and a
C6: factory application, 16 KiB stbc partition, reserved ckpt_a / ckpt_b;
no flash write or erase during RUN.
All PLC functions and overflow checks remain present.
Source/rendered diagrams do not establish flash/RAM fit, timing or hardware proof.
old host core/cycle/VM and 1.1 assertion corpus
Historical executors and HIR local-initializer helpers are test-only.
Product cycles, explicit POU entries and restarts use the same core engine.
Diagnostic text is separate from stable machine error identities.
user POU call that can nest yields destination and cursor
common return validation and output copyback
library call, or leaf POU call run in place
frame pushed when an operation needs it
other calls through the dispatcher's own
preserve identities, generation, live values, debug/IR/fault state
authoritative images; deadline suspension for safety delivery
borrowed facade; optional register tier omitted
Architecture source view, not a compilation or release/hardware acceptance record.
Full and runtime-only hosts share execution; selected service graphs differ.
No production Expr evaluator, lazy VM build or second mutable PLC authority.
